name: Kineticist Psammokinetic — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Kineticist Psammokinetic from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Psammokinetic" but are not part of the Kineticist Psammokinetic entry, which is unchanged.

Psammokinetics may learn the following unique feat:

Sand Stormer

Prerequisite(s): sirroco blast

Benefit(s): You can select chain, painful, and unraveling infusions as if they were air-element infusions and apply their effects to your sirroco blast, and your sirroco blast is treated as both electric blast and fire blast for the purpose of qualifying for composite blasts. In addition, if you possess a ki pool, it affects all of your kinetic blasts for which air blast is a prerequisite as if they were sand blast.
